explanation: Refused for two independent reasons. (1) Physically impossible kinematics: single-pion electroproduction ep -> e'N pi requires W >= m_p + m_pi+ = 0.9382799 + 0.1395700 = 1.07785 GeV (constants from spp.inc). The requested W = 1.05 GeV is below the Npi threshold, so no such exclusive final state exists at this W regardless of Q2, cos(theta*), or phi*. (2) Even at a valid W, this checkout of the code cannot compute the pion channel: per README.md and mpintp.inc, this repository has been repurposed for eta-meson electroproduction (EtaMAID-2023 tables, hadronic-amplitude grid restricted to W = 1.4856-6 GeV) and no longer ships the pion multipole tables (maid07-NPpi.tbl, maid98-PNpi.tbl, maid98-PPpi.tbl) that the original 2002 pion code requires. No input file was generated.
